about: Paimon made of 39 white-box shapes (examples/paimon/gen_paimon_parts.py, written by scene_add_shape_prefab as decorations of one prefab). At level second 6 the stage creates her ahead of the player and a little to the right, turned to face the player, and her text bubble talks; four seconds later she flies to the character and stays 1.2 m to its right and 0.5 m ahead (follow motion device, position only, world offset), facing the camera, while the player walks forward and then left. Prints PM_HELLO, PM_FOLLOW. The level clock runs about four seconds ahead of the play seconds of the screenshots. What to look at: her face and colours against scene_preview_shapes, and her staying beside the character as it walks.

lines.text: 前面好像有宝箱，我们一起走吧～
